answer: Vehicle inspection streak with test centre records is the check: an annual inspection passed at one centre for a decade. A farm faking 141 aliases needs 141 separate inspection streaks, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The shale check runs in the open: 141 fakes pay the full price 141 times, one honest agent pays once, and the copper trail in the ledger makes the ocean cost visible to everyone.
